description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in one and two variables: van der Corput's lemma with explicit constants, non-stationary and nondegenerate stationary phase, the uniform fold and D4 (umbilic) estimates with the D4 leading term and its closed-form constant, and front ends in Mathlib's idiom. Statements are frozen and timestamped before their proofs and replayed by several independent kernels.
keywords: MSC2020: 68V20 Formalization of mathematics in connection with theorem provers
MSC2020: 03B35 Mechanization of proofs and logical operations
name: OscInt: uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in Lean 4 and Mathlib
